runs.text:
DragonForce are a genre-defining force in power metal. RIAA platinum-selling, Grammy-nominated, and globally celebrated as the world's fastest band. Founded in London in 1999 by guitarists Herman Li and Sam Totman, the band has spent over two decades rewriting the rules of heavy metal with their signature sound, impossibly fast guitar solos, soaring anthemic choruses, and a live show that is as exhilarating as it is technically breathtaking.

Now entering a new era, DragonForce have joined forces with internationally acclaimed vocalist Alissa White-Gluz, who will feature on their forthcoming 10th studio album and upcoming tour dates. Her addition marks a bold new chapter for the band, expanding their sonic range while building on the technical precision and intensity that define the DragonForce sound.
